offlineMethod: Saved a complete 12.0 MB package on port8769, terminated its local HTTP server, reloaded the app through the service worker, opened cathedral story and observed actual WAV playback controls/duration.

No live LLM or RAG integration
Two browser assertions were inconclusive because the page changed between actions
No full WCAG or VoiceOver certification
